package.name: sim_lidar_bridge
package.description: Sim-side bridge for the Isaac Go2 environment. Receives the real XT16 raycast point cloud + robot pose from isaac_env over UDP and republishes them on the SAME ROS2 topics the real robot uses (/xt16/lidar_points PointCloud2, /odom, TF), and forwards Nav2's /cmd_vel_smoothed back to Isaac over UDP. This lets the real Nav2 / costmap / MPPI stack run unchanged against sim data. On the real robot this node is not run: the Hesai driver publishes /xt16/lidar_points and go2_nav_bridge publishes /odom + drives the robot, on the identical topics.
